What it solves

Asking about software usually costs more than it should

You fill in a twelve-field form, a salesperson calls who can't say what the product actually does, and after the third call you still don't know whether it's any use to you. We prefer the short route: ask whatever you like over WhatsApp and someone who has implemented this answers.

  • Long forms for a short question
  • Generic answers from someone who doesn't know the product
  • Canned demos that don't answer your case
  • Quotes that take a week to arrive
  • Not knowing who to write to once you're a customer
  • Channels nobody answers outside the capital

How it works

In three steps

  1. You write up your case

    Over WhatsApp or email. With the country, the size and what's failing, we can already say something useful.

  2. We look at it together

    A call or a short video call with the system in front of us, on a case like yours.

  3. You decide

    With the price of the modules you need and with no lock-in. If it doesn't fit, we'll be the first to say so.

In detail

What you notice using it every day

Say which country in your first message

It changes the whole answer: the tax rules, the documents and the mandatory filings are not the same in the Dominican Republic as in Colombia or Guatemala.

Say how many companies

One company or a group with several isn't the same system or the same price. Knowing it up front saves two emails.

Tell us what's failing today, not which module you want

Often the module being asked for isn't the one that solves the problem being described. It's better to start from the problem.

You can try it before writing

The demo goes into the real platform with sample data. Arriving with your questions already formed shortens the conversation a lot.

If you're a customer, use soporte@

Writing to info@ about an incident puts it in the sales queue and takes longer. The support channel is the one with committed response times.

We don't sell your data

What you write to us is used to answer you. It's in the privacy policy, along with what is kept and for how long.

Common questions

Questions

What is Zyntello's WhatsApp number?

It's +1 829 639 9877. The same number works for WhatsApp and for calling.

Which email should I write to?

To info@zyntello.com if you're not a customer yet —quotes, questions, demos— and to soporte@zyntello.com if you already are. The second one has response times committed in writing.

Do you work outside the Dominican Republic?

Yes. We operate in the Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Colombia, Guatemala and Costa Rica, and we give remote support outside those countries.

Can I see the product before talking to anyone?

Yes. There's a demo that goes into the real platform with sample data, and every module has its own page explaining what it does.

How long do you take to reply?

Over WhatsApp, usually the same working day. For customers, the times are in the published Service Level Agreement, which is a commitment and not an estimate.

What do you do with my data if I write to you?

Use them to answer you. They aren't sold or passed on; the published privacy policy explains what is kept and for how long.
